tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, development builds included, going forward. Testing that needs a certificate the system does not already trust is done with self-signed certificates rather than by turning verification off. The project also records a decision to use https everywhere, with no plaintext exception, since certificate management is now in place.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
